none: PAS NLM-AB2E56: Roman Coin: Radiate, possibly of Trebonius Gallus
contea di ritrovamento: Nottinghamshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy with silver wash Coin. Radiate, possibly of Trebonius Gallus (251-253), Reece period 12. Obverse description: Radiate bust draped with neckerchief right. Obverse inscription: IMP ?TR[---]AVG; CR offers alternative reading as for Gordian III. Reverse description: Female figure standing , left arm extended holding rudder, right with cloak over arm or (CR) holding cornucopiae.. Reverse…
